data.title: The card behind the counter
data.situation:
Before the first customer arrived, Mina pinned a small card behind the counter. As manager, she would check prices and speak to suppliers. She had employed Jay to repair bags and help with customer service. Her sister Noor would join them on Saturdays, so the staff would not all work the same hours. Jay had worked alone before; having colleagues was new to him. Mina gave him responsibility for writing down repair requests, then showed him where the blank cards were kept. When an older customer appeared at the door, Jay stood up too quickly and knocked his pencil onto the floor. His friendly manner mattered more than the pencil. He picked it up, listened, and wrote the customer’s name carefully. COUNTER CARD
Mina — prices and supplier calls.
Jay — repair requests and collection notes.
Noor — Saturday counter service.
If an order is unclear, ask before sending it to the bench.

readingBlocks.zh: 第一位顾客到来之前，米娜在柜台后钉了一张小卡片。作为经理，她负责核对价格和联系供应商。她雇了杰伊修包并协助顾客服务。姐姐努尔周六也会来，所以员工的工作时间并不完全相同。杰伊过去独自工作，有同事还是新鲜事。米娜让他负责记录维修要求，又给他看空白卡片放在哪里。一位年长顾客来到门口，杰伊起身太快，把铅笔碰到了地上。比起掉落的铅笔，他待人的友好态度更重要。他捡起笔，听顾客说话，仔细写下姓名。

COUNTER CARD
Mina — prices and supplier calls.
Jay — repair requests and collection notes.
Noor — Saturday counter service.
If an order is unclear, ask before sending it to the bench.
readingBlocks.zh:
柜台值班卡
米娜——价格和供应商电话。
杰伊——维修要求和取件记录。
努尔——周六柜台服务。
订单不清楚时，先询问，再送到工作台。

glossary.zh: 负责经营或管理业务的人
glossary.note: the manager of a shop；本课不是系统管理程序。

externalEvidence.definition: someone who controls resources and expenditures

glossary.note: staff 表示全体工作人员；一个人通常称 a member of staff。
glossary.example: The staff did not all work the same hours.
glossary.exampleZh: 员工的工作时间并不完全相同。

glossary.note: people you work with；单数 colleague。
glossary.example: Having colleagues was new to Jay.
glossary.exampleZh: 有同事对杰伊来说是新鲜事。

glossary.note: take responsibility for + 名词或动名词：负责某事。
glossary.example: Jay took responsibility for repair requests.

glossary.zh: 对别人说话或待人的态度
glossary.note: a friendly manner；这里不是完成工作的方法。
glossary.example: Jay had a friendly manner with customers.

externalEvidence.definition: a way of acting or behaving

glossary.note: employ someone to do something；与 Q06 使用某种方法的 employ 区分。
glossary.example: Mina employed Jay to repair bags.
